claims.claim: La Mascota Bakery is a Boyle Heights bakery on Whittier Blvd that sells holiday tamales.
claims.evidence: Time Out lists La Mascota at 2715 Whittier Blvd with daily hours and calls it a Boyle Heights institution since 1952. The Infatuation reviews its tamales, sold by the dozen with online pre-orders.
